name: Dust Spam Evasion
summary: Attacker sprays 200 sub-dust txs to push mean anomalyScore down and create 'noise fatigue'. Learning loop responds by weighting by-value rather than by-count.
expectedOutcome: Flood of PendingTxEvents with tiny value. Detector's windowed anomaly rate inflates; confidence floor temporarily raised. Learning-loop generation fires, commits new policyHash with a value-weighted term.

steps.text: 200 dust txs inbound — anomaly baseline climbing
Detector: evasion signature — high-rate low-value swarm
Learning loop: policy rotated to weight by tx value, not count.
